metadata.title: कांतिलाल रोत इंटरव्यू | डूंगरपुर | बाप उम्मीदवार Kanti Lal Roat | Interview | BAP Rajasthan
metadata.description: Kanti Lal Roat is a tribal leader from south Rajasthan. At present he is key member of the team of tribal leaders who have formed a new political party BAP ( Bharat Tribal Party). In the past Kanti Lal Roat was associated with Bhartiya Tribal Party and many other tribal organisations. He is a claimant from Dungarpur assembly constituency in Rajasthan.
